name: saleor-graphql-automation
description: Production-grade GraphQL e-commerce automation showcase built on Saleor 3.23 using Screenplay Pattern, Serenity/JS, Cucumber, and TypeScript.
author: Gary Brooks

scripts.sut:migrate: docker compose -f docker/docker-compose.yml run --rm api python3 manage.py migrate
scripts.sut:seed: docker compose -f docker/docker-compose.yml run --rm api python3 manage.py populatedb --createsuperuser
scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:contract && npm run test:api
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm run test:unit && npm run check:smoke-safety && npm run test:contract && npm run test:smoke && npm run test:api
